a_gap_is: a print whose sequence number steps by anything but 1 or 2 from the print before (Greg, 2026-11-24: only a real break); the day volume ahead of the prints is a number here and resets nothing

CL03.title: the first step made by a fill

CL04.title: a level that has only been eaten

CL05.title: a trade leg's first step with the exhaustion line on its side

CL06.title: both quotes have stepped the same way

CL07.title: fresh trading on the dipole's side

CL09.title: the first step made by a cancel

CL10.title: the price runs against the dipole: with the price

CL11.title: the price runs against the dipole: against the price

CL13.title: paying up through more than one level

CL14.title: the other side arrives at the top step of a run

CL15.title: the step back and the return

CL16.title: a step of the quote first shown by a print with no side

CL17.title: the print with no side, taken at the quote it traded at

leakage_gate: the cut-equals-whole check stands in for odcore/leakage.py on a replay; nothing here is a backtest result
not_testable_on_real_data: the 4:44 pm stop, the halt hour and the settlement window (the recordings cover about 6:00 to 6:26 pm on the feed)

stand_ins.CL13: prints of one side sharing one feed time at more than one price
stand_ins.CL16-CL17: made for the print with no side (Greg, 2026-11-24): given every print; rule 5 does not hold for them
stand_ins.S1: the clock: the lines are made on the feed trade time in ms (as ns) and sequence
stand_ins.S2: the event mark: a rule decides at the feed message (print) that shows its trigger; "a later exchange event" is read as "a later feed trade time"
stand_ins.S3: the quotes: the print's own bid and offer only (G1); quote messages are recorded, never read by a rule
stand_ins.S4: the trades: the lines and the rules use prints that carry a side; prints with no side are counted
stand_ins.S5: a moment at which trades only leave a span is known at the next print; a close that depends on it is made then and marked known late
stand_ins.S6: the end-of-trade-day close cannot be sent; the flatten at the stop takes its place (not in Part A)
stand_ins.S7: CL01 to CL15 are not given a print with no side (their rule 5); a step of the quote or a trade leg's end that such a print shows closes their trade at the next print that has a side: the line names the print that showed it ("closed") and the print acted at ("acted_at") and is marked known late

what: replay of a 7e recording through the paper runner: sends nothing
